title: PRETZEL: A Benchmark for Cyclic Peptide Structure Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.31708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Macrocyclic peptides are a growing therapeutic modality, and co-folding models are increasingly used to predict their structures. Yet published evaluations rely on small, loosely curated target sets that differ from paper to paper, so results are not comparable, and most report pose RMSD alone, without checking whether the predicted molecule is chemically correct. translated_title: PRETZEL：一个环肽结构预测基准
translated_abstract: 大环肽是一类日益受到关注的药物形式，共折叠模型正越来越多地被用于预测其结构。然而，已发表的评估依赖小型且整理松散的靶标集合，各论文之间互不相同，导致结果缺乏可比性；此外，大多数评估仅报告构象RMSD，而不验证预测的分子在化学上是否正确。我们提出了PRETZEL（Prediction of Ring-Enclosed Topology: Zero-shot Evaluation of cycLic peptides，环封闭拓扑预测：环肽零样本评估），这是一个包含285个精心整理的环肽-蛋白质复合物的基准，涵盖三种环化化学类型，且所有数据均晚于所评估的每个模型的训练截止时间。PRETZEL包含三个组成部分：PRETZEL-SET，一个按环化化学和化学新颖性进行标注的评估集；PRETZEL-TWIST，一个规范层，将单一的标准大环描述编译为每个引擎的原生输入格式并验证返回的结构；以及PRETZEL-SALT，一个评估……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了PRETZEL——一个包含285个环肽-蛋白复合物、涵盖三种环化化学且全部晚于模型训练截止时间的标准化基准，实现了对环肽结构预测模型零样本、可比较且含化学正确性验证的评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PRETZEL, a standardized zero-shot benchmark of 285 curated cyclic peptide-protein complexes spanning three cyclization chemistries, all post-dating every evaluated model's training cutoff, enabling comparable and chemically verified evaluation of cyclic peptide structure prediction models.
